sentences.text:
This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India, Praying To Issue
A Writ Or Order Or Direction Or Any Other
Appropriate Writ Declaring That The Contemplated
Action Of The Respondent-Authorities To Demolish
The Portion Of The Buildings Existing On Their
Respective Schedule Properties To This Writ Petition
And Also Taking O9Ver The Vacant Lands Without
Following The Procedures Established By Law Namely
The Mandatory Provisions Contained Under "The Right
To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land
Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act,
2013" And Payment Of Compensation As Provided
Therein As One Without Jurisdiction And Without
Authority Of Law And Etc.
 This Writ Petition Coming On For Hearing, This
Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

Sri.S.V.Prakash., learned counsel for the petitioners and Smt.A.R.Sharadamba., learned AGA for respondents have appeared in person.
Counsel Sri.S.V.Prakash., submits that the Writ Petition may be dismissed as having become infructuous.
The oral submission made on behalf of learned counsel for petitioners is placed on record.
The Writ Petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.

Sd/-
